title: NASA CEA RP-1311 Example 3 hydrocarbon-air HP equilibrium

source.name: Chemical Equilibrium with Applications (CEA)
source.citation: NASA CEA documentation, RP-1311 Example 3, current official publication.

transcription: Source-faithful frozen mole fractions for explicit CEA Air, 0.4 C7H8(L) + 0.6 C8H18(L), O/F=17, and pressures 100, 10, and 1 bar. CEA trace threshold is 1e-15; values below it are retained when the species is printed at another pressure.
